entities.summary: Unione Sportiva Lecce is a professional Italian football club based in Lecce, Apulia. The club play in Serie A for the 2025–26 season, the top level of the Italian football pyramid. Lecce plays its home games at Stadio Via del Mare, which has a capacity of 31,533 spectators. San Matteo (Lecce) is a church building in Europe, established in 1667.
